claim: Impression West Lake (officially 'Enduring Memories of Hangzhou') is a 55-minute outdoor night show directed by Zhang Yimou, staged on Yuehu Lake at 82 Beishan Road, performing daily at 19:40 with tickets roughly CNY 360-960.
quote: The show performs daily at 19:40... Tickets range from CNY 360/pp ~ CNY 960/pp... The performance runs for 55 minutes. Directed by the renowned filmmaker Yimou Zhang... located at 82 Beishan Road, opposite to Yuefei Temple

claim: The Impression West Lake stage is built 3 cm below the lake surface so performers appear to walk on water, making it a signature light-music-dance spectacle on West Lake.
quote: a stage has been built 3 centimeters below the surface, Impression West Lake is a spectacle of light, music, dance and theatrics

claim: The Hangzhou Grand Canal night cruise runs about one hour from Wulinmen Wharf, featuring lighting designed by artist Roger Narboni, a commentator, and onboard Longjing tea tasting; a longer 2.5-hour Grand Canal + Qiantang River cruise departs 18:30 daily.
quote: The night cruise takes an hour... comes alive after sunset with a stunning display of lights designed by Roger Narboni... visitors can also sample Longjing Tea... The special 2.5-hour cruise of the Grand Canal and Qiantang River departs at 18:30 every day from Wulinmen Dock

claim: Wushan Night Market is Hangzhou's biggest night market with 400+ stalls open 6:30pm-11pm near West Lake, known for street food like scallion oil pancakes, skewers, and Hangzhou dumplings.
quote: Wushan Night Market is the most popular and biggest night market in Hangzhou, with more than 400 stalls open from 6:30pm to 11pm... must-try dishes including scallion oil pancakes, grilled skewers

claim: Traditional teahouses cluster on Hefang/Qinghefang Street and Hubin Road; Qingteng (Green Vine) is one of Hangzhou's earliest teahouses, offering a Jiangnan-garden ambiance and an all-you-can-eat snack buffet with tea orders.
quote: Qingteng (Green Vine) is one of Hangzhou's earliest teahouses... Hefang Street, a historic pedestrian street, is home to several traditional tea houses... The Hubin Road area features stylish tea rooms with lake views

claim: For an authentic farmer-style tea experience, Meijiawu Village has 160+ family-run tea houses and Longjing Village hosts the 'Imperial 18 Bushes', best visited during the March-May harvest; visitors are warned about a West Lake 'tea ceremony' scam with forced bills of CNY 1,000-5,000.
quote: Meijiawu Village is a key production base for West Lake Longjing, featuring over 160 family-run tea houses... Be extremely wary of English-speaking individuals approaching you... inviting you to a 'tea ceremony'... forced bills ranging from 1,000 to 5,000

claim: Hangzhou's main bar street is Nanshan Lu (West Lake bar street), with pubs and bars clustered along Nanshan Road and Hubin Road; the area north of West Lake near the university campuses also draws nightlife crowds.
quote: Nanshan Lu (or the West Lake bar street) is where most of the nightlife in Hangzhou happens... pubs, bars and teahouses are mainly clustered in Nanshan Road and Hubin Road

claim: Other Hangzhou night options include the free West Lake Music Fountain (7pm & 8pm nightly, 15-20 min) and the Qianjiang New Town light show projecting 700,000 LEDs across 30 high-rises (6:30pm & 7:30pm Tue/Fri/Sat).
quote: Music Fountain Show... Time: 7pm and 8pm nightly... Qianjiang New Town Light Show... 6:30pm and 7:30pm on Tuesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays... 700,000 LED lights on 30 high-rise buildings

claim: The Dragon Boat Festival falls on June 19, 2026; Hangzhou hosts the Xixi International Dragon Boat Race at Xixi Wetland (under 5 km from West Lake) plus accessible races on West Lake near Gushan and the Su Causeway, though late June brings the Meiyu rainy season.
quote: The Hangzhou Xixi International Dragon Boat Race is held annually on Dragon Boat Festival (June 19, 2026)... races held on the West Lake, particularly along the southern shore near Solitary Hill (Gushan) and Su Causeway... Yangtze delta... enters Meiyu rainy season in late June
